evidence.quote: We propose a $32 million class fund, distributed automatically using Brightline’s member and payment records, plus $7 million in fees and expenses subject to court approval.
Brightline can offer a $26 million class fund plus $5 million in fees and expenses, subject to court approval, with any unawarded fees going to the class.
we can reduce our fee request to your proposed $5 million if Brightline increases the class fund to $30 million.

summary: Plaintiff-side counsel first raised fees in their opening term sheets, and fee amounts were negotiated alongside class-fund amounts before any final class relief was settled. Whitcombe expressly linked a reduced fee request to a higher class fund. The transcript does not clearly show class counsel prioritizing its own fees over the class, defense leveraging fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading court declaration.
